residual_gaps: IMPORTED_RESEARCH_MODULES_NOT_IN_B: a research module that the sealing path imports but that is not one of the four in module_source_sha16 -- nfl.research.q7.panel and nfl.research.q8.audit are the live examples -- is in neither B nor E. Remedy: hash each imported module file by content into the candidate identity. That is candidate.py, not this module.

NON_PY_SOURCE_NOT_IN_B: a frozen parameter file under a source root (nfl/production/nonqb/frozen/*.json.gz) is not source by SOURCE_SUFFIXES. For Q9 these are covered by the candidate parameter hashes in E. Remedy elsewhere: seal the resolved path and sha256, which is WS18 F1.

THREAD_ENV_RECORDED_NOT_HASHED: promote to RUNTIME_HASHED_KEYS if and when a measured draw difference is attributed to thread count. Not before -- an unmeasured coefficient in an identity is a silent constant.
STAGING_NOT_DISTINGUISHED: B hashes worktree CONTENT, so a staged and an unstaged edit of identical bytes are the same identity. Deliberate: the bytes the interpreter reads are the bytes that matter.

scope.research_out_of_scope_why: causal research modules are hashed by content into module_source_sha16, which is inside spec_sha256 (identity E), which is inside the fingerprint. Adding nfl/research/** to B would move every run id for thousands of non-causal files.
